questions.stem: On the standard scientific pH scale, which measures from 0 to 14, what specific number represents a perfectly chemically neutral substance, like pure distilled water?
questions.explanation: The pH scale ranges from 0 to 14. A pH of exactly 7 is neutral (neither acidic nor basic), representing pure water. Values less than 7 indicate acidity, while values greater than 7 indicate a base (alkaline).
